profile.legalName: Association Of Community Rehabilitation Educators Inc
profile.summary: A nonprofit that sets competency-based training standards for employment professionals who help people with disabilities find jobs. It reviews and endorses training curricula and issues certificates, including a Basic Customized Employment Services certificate, and keeps a registry of certified professionals.
